extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4. Multi-country Communication: only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, e-government, e-services, broadband, roaming, 5G, workers, social security, EURES, interoperability, electronic, data, connectivity, information society, technology) and full reading of every page with a hit, including the whole North Macedonia summary in Annex 1 (pages 53-57), the conclusions (pages 34-42) and the digital part of Annex 2 on the Economic and Investment Plan (pages 77-80). Annex 3 statistical tables have no in-scope indicators. Period covered left empty: the register gives none. Left out: cybercrime passages (pages 17-18, R21); the court case management system ACCMIS (page 55, back-office, R12); Common Regional Market agreements that are not digital; digital skills not linked to an in-scope recommendation; broadband and computing projects naming only other countries. Chapter 2 appears only in the Annex 1 Cluster 2 summary (page 57). Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
